routeActions: Jump across the original entrance islands and moving step. Walk around the box, push it about four meters toward the opening, then crouch-jump from its top to the high red coin.
Follow the W-shaped seesaw and the steep original non-slippery ramp. Take the long lower loop, jump across the rotating octagon, and collect the red coin on the plant ledge.
Drop down the return steps to the large lower platform. Step onto its small outside ledge for the hidden red coin, then jump back up the steps to the narrow seesaw.
Run and jump from the seesaw onto a low approaching Ferris platform. Stay aboard as it rises and moves left, then move to its left edge and jump onto the return ledge.
Cross the gaps along the lower return ledge. Crouch-jump onto the far-left raised step, turn around, and keep running-jump momentum for the double jump across the next two source steps.
Follow the upper curved return path to the purple switch. Cross the gap to the staircase and crouch-jump up all six raised steps before its timer expires.

Climb the far-right ascending loop and jump for the high red coin at its outer corner. Return around the other side, jumping across the two flame jets before descending to the arrow platform approach.
Jump onto the arrow platform and let a physical rider activate it. Jump onto the first raised beam as it approaches, wait for the platform beneath it, then drop back onto the moving platform.

Crouch-jump from the arrow onto the first narrow crossbeam, then onto the small peaked support for the suspended red coin. Drop to the next beam, rejoin the arrow, and repeat across the remaining raised supports.
Cross the two rotating octagons, taking the red coin on the first. Jump into the tall pole, climb to its top, turn toward the upper ledge, and jump away.
Wait for the left upper slider to move toward the short pole. Ride it to the right, run toward its end, and jump toward the short pole and its red coin. Grab its top and face the next slider.
Wait on the short pole until the right slider returns. Jump onto it, then jump up to the central landing and follow the rising path to the final pair of Ferris wheels.
Wait for a low approaching platform on the first wheel, run to the edge, and jump aboard. Ride toward the upper-left part of its orbit and crouch-jump onto a low rising platform of the higher wheel.
Ride the higher wheel toward the left exit and jump onto the upper walkway. Cross the final wind platform while holding forward against the wind.

At the first ending step, jump sideways over its rail and drop onto the broad ledge underneath. Walk beneath the staircase to collect the eighth red coin. Return to the side and crouch-jump back over the rail.
Hop up the last steps, walk around the original end pipe, and jump into the revealed star beyond it. The star must finish its rising and bouncing appearance before it can be collected.

mission.name: Eight Red Coins
mission.sourceScope: Eight-red-coin secret star in the complete platform approach stage. Separate Bowser boss arena and key/Grand Star are outside this first-star mission.
